hints.title: Vertical Scanning Character Alignment
hints.text: The common prefix cannot be longer than the shortest word. How can comparing characters column by column across all words stop at the earliest mismatch?

hints.title: Prefix Shortening Boundary Invariant
hints.text: Any mismatch at index i in any word proves the longest common prefix can be at most i characters long.

hints.title: Column-wise Character Comparison Procedure
hints.text: Iterate index i through characters of the first word. For each remaining word in the list, verify if i equals word length or if character at index i does not match. When mismatch occurs, return substring up to i. If loop completes, return entire first word.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(S) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise string comparisons may perform redundant operations if an early word has an immediate mismatch.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Vertical character scanning examines at most S total characters in O(S) time with O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize edge cases like empty string lists and stop early upon the first mismatch.
